# rime-stroke data

This directory contains the upstream `stroke.dict.yaml` data from
https://github.com/rime/rime-stroke.

- Pinned commit: `1e8fff9b9494ddec23b0cbc526bcfd8171a6fd48`
- Upstream license: LGPL-3.0-only; see `LICENSE`.
- The Android TSV asset is a generated build input derived from this file.
- The converter preserves the upstream character-to-stroke mapping and does
  not include Rime runtime code.
